d: From Ukraine to West Asia, global conflicts are creating major business opportunities for American companies. More than 50 US oil and gas firms made over $130 billion in profits between April and September as disrupted supplies pushed energy prices higher and buyers turned to American producers. Europe is also buying more US natural gas after reducing its reliance on Russia, while India is considering longer-term gas deals with American suppliers. The defence industry is benefiting too.
